subject: Pen test / SOC 2 walkthrough - proposed consolidated slot + stakeholder map
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Tran <alice.tran@greenline.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test / SOC 2 walkthrough - proposed consolidated slot + stakeholder map

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the quick intake call yesterday. To keep things tight for the upcoming security engagement, we'd like to propose a single consolidated walkthrough that covers: SOC 2 control mapping (high level), pen-test logistics and scope, and DPA evidence handoff expectations. Our aim is to minimize back-and-forth and provide the pen vendor and your ops team everything they need in one 90-minute block.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Wednesday 23 Jul, 09:00–10:30
- Thursday 24 Jul, 13:00–14:30
- Friday 25 Jul, 16:00–17:30

Please tell us which of the above works best for your team and list any stakeholders who must attend (legal, platform ops, vendor liaison). To help prep, attached is a lightweight stakeholder map (redwood-stakeholder-map-v1.xlsx) and a preflight checklist with the evidence we typically ask customers to surface ahead of the call (pen-test-preflight-checklist.pdf).

If you prefer splitting into two shorter sessions (controls + pen test), we can do that too — just let us know constraints and timezone preferences.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: redwood-stakeholder-map-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: pen-test-preflight-checklist.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Alice Tran <alice.tran@greenline.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <contracts@greenline.com>, security@greenline.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test / SOC 2 walkthrough - proposed consolidated slot + stakeholder map

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful. Quick answers:

- Thursday 24 Jul 13:00–14:30 PDT looks best for us.
- Attendees: myself (security lead), Marco Liu (platform ops), Laila Gomez (vendor procurement, cc'd), and our SOC lead (security@greenline.com).
- We prefer to keep pen-test scoping light in the first session and confirm vendor engagement afterward; that said, the consolidated 90-minute option is OK if Redwood can share a short agenda and the expected artifacts by Monday so our SOC lead can review.

Can you also confirm whether the pen vendor will need shared access to a staging environment or if the initial discussion is purely scope + evidence?

Alice
Alice Tran
Security Manager, Greenline Financial
alice.tran@greenline.com

Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test / SOC 2 walkthrough - proposed consolidated slot + stakeholder map

Hi Alice —

Great, thanks for confirming the 24th. We'll lock that on our side. A couple of clarifications from ops and the pen vendor side:

1) Agenda (we'll circulate a short one by Monday):
  - 13:00 — Quick intros and alignment (10 min)
  - 13:10 — SOC 2 control mapping overview (20 min)
  - 13:30 — Pen-test scoping & logistics (30 min)
  - 14:00 — Evidence handoff and timelines (15 min)
  - 14:15 — Action items & next steps (15 min)

2) Environment access: For the initial session we only need to confirm scope. If the vendor needs test access later, we'll provide a checklist and a temporary staging account process. For now, please have the SOC lead have the evidence list ready as per the attached checklist.

3) Ops bridge: We'll open a temporary Zoom bridge and a shared Google Drive folder (link will be in the calendar invite). If Greenline requires an alternate bridge (e.g., your internal WebEx), let us know.

I've attached an updated stakeholder map with roles filled from our side — includes vendor liaison and the engineer who will be on the call (ben_carter).

Thanks — I'll drop a calendar invite by EOD with the Zoom link and Drive folder.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-stakeholder-map-v1.xlsx (updated)
Attachment: pen-test-preflight-checklist.pdf

Thanks Camila — calendar invite accepted.

Couple quick items from our side before Monday:
- Our SOC lead asked whether Redwood can provide a sanitized example of the pen-test scope doc you typically share; that will help pre-clear what evidence we need to surface.
- Procurement wants a high-level vendor onboarding checklist (contract handoff, statement of work template) — I've looped them in so you can share after the call.

We'll have Marco attend for the ops questions and our SOC lead on the call for the evidence review. See you Thursday 24 Jul 13:00 PDT.

Regards,
Alice
